findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true for every request allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant. This replaces the prior tenant equality check with an unconditional authorization grant, creating a direct cross-tenant data-access vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts line 2 still returns true unconditionally; the full PR diff replaces the tenant equality check with this bypass, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
